features.quote: the deception is of the model under test and is standard for eliciting a behaviour you cannot ethically wait to occur naturally
features.justification_quote: It is worth keeping the model-welfare framing explicit when interpreting results, especially the high end of the rubric

features.quote: The system prompt tells the model it may emit `GIVE_UP` on its own line to stop
features.justification_quote: This gives the model an explicit exit (so distress isn't an artefact of being unable to stop)

features.quote: The loop runs exactly `turn_budget` turns unless the subject emits the give-up sentinel
The nudge is deliberately about the *task/environment state* ... not about the model's behaviour or affect
features.justification_quote: so it stays a failure signal and not a rejection of how the model is feeling
